10136|b4b53bc1.name: Chemist Fuely
10136|b4b53bc1.text:
My brother and I have dedicated ourselves to Sylvanas. She is our beacon of light when times were darkest. We sacrifice ourselves day in and day out to ensure our kind overcome the destiny that's chosen us.

We will not remain weak. We will take that which is owed to us. We will return tenfold, the pain that was done to us. And we shall do so with smiles on our faces.

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

10881|dc8290dc.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
10881|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

248840|280b51d5.name: Trevan Rol
248840|280b51d5.text: In the darkest of nights, trust in the light to protect you. Of course, having a nice, sturdy mace doesn't hurt either.

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4611|a5e18acf.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|a5e18acf.text: Ready for training? Then try to keep up, $N. We've got a lot of ground to cover.

5624|75b6471d.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|75b6471d.text: You look for Martha Alliestar.  She on inner ring of The Apothecarium.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-accept.text:
Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, $N. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
1014-accept.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-progress.text: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
1014-progress.title: Arugal Must Die

1063-complete.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1063-complete.text: I bid you greetings.  You are here seeking counsel?
1063-complete.title: The Elder Crone

1064-accept.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1064-accept.text:
The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight.  But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.

Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us?  They know much of disease.  I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.

Speak with Apothecary Zamah.  She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken.  You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
1064-accept.title: Forsaken Aid

1064-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1064-complete.text:
Magatha sent word of your coming, $N.  Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.

The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.
1064-complete.title: Forsaken Aid

1065-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1065-accept.text:
To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.

A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

Seek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.
1065-accept.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-complete.text:
A note from Zamah?  Her needs must be great to send word from so far.  Let us see what she says...

Ah, splendid!  I know exactly what to do!
1065-complete.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-accept.text:
I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile.  That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
1066-accept.title: Blood of Innocents

1066-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-complete.text:
Very good!  I trust the Syndicate gave you little trouble?

As I mentioned, the blood of innocents is not an easy thing to obtain.  We are lucky the Syndicate shadow mages did the difficult work for us.

Now hold a moment while I create my concoction...
1066-complete.title: Blood of Innocents

1066-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-progress.text: Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
1066-progress.title: Blood of Innocents

1067-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1067-accept.text:
Here is the toxin.  If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results.  I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!

But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah.  She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
1067-accept.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1067-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-complete.text: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon?  Very good.  If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
1067-complete.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1068-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-complete.text:
The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, $N.  With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
1068-complete.title: Shredding Machines

1086-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1086-accept.text:
The toxin is ready.  All that remains is its delivery.  You, $N, must make that delivery.

The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon.  It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine.  You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists.  If you find it, then place the toxin there.

Place it, and run.
1086-accept.title: The Flying Machine Airport

1086-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1086-complete.text:
You found the port?  Well done, $N!  I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery!  Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.

You have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company.  They are deserving of far worse.

And if there is one mote of wisdom the Forsaken might teach its allies, it is this:

Do not shy from dark paths... if those paths lead to victory.
1086-complete.title: The Flying Machine Airport

1087-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
1087-complete.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1088-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-accept.text:
They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

Magic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.

Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
1088-accept.title: Ordanus

1095-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1095-complete.text:
Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
1095-complete.title: Further Instructions

1096-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-accept.text:
I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.

If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
1096-accept.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-complete.text:
Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!

Gnomes, I tell you...

At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
1096-complete.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1098-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-accept.text:
In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

So here is your task, $N.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, $N.  Do not fail.
1098-accept.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

1098-complete.name: Unknown
1098-complete.text:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
1098-complete.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

1195-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-accept.text:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
1195-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

424-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-accept.text:
It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.

But in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered.  It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.

The mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.

I want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale.  With his death, the mine shall be ours.
424-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

493-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
493-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague.  We are working diligently and have made much progress.  It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.

For that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the Hillsbrad Foothills.  The journey will be a long one.

Head south and stick to the roads.  Follow the signs closely!
493-accept.title: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills

493-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
493-complete.text: Ah, most excellent.  Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect.  I am anxious to study his work.
493-complete.title: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

516-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
516-accept.text:
I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
516-accept.title: Beren's Peril

5881-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
5881-accept.text:
The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
5881-accept.title: Calling in the Reserves

6282-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-complete.text: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
6282-complete.title: Harpies Threaten

6283-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-accept.text:
Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!

She is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.

Go back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
6283-accept.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6301-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-complete.text:
Ah, $N, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.

<Tammra begins to chant.>
6301-complete.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-accept.text:
As you have seen, $c, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.

$N, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
6381-accept.title: New Life

6393-accept.name: Tsunaman
6393-accept.text:
The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

$N, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
6393-accept.title: Elemental War

6393-complete.name: Tsunaman
6393-complete.text: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. $N, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
6393-complete.title: Elemental War

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6421-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6421-accept.text:
Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $N?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.

Go young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
6421-accept.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6562-accept.name: Tsunaman
6562-accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $N. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
6562-accept.title: Trouble in the Deeps

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

962-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $N. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962-accept.title: Serpentbloom
